title: Member only event
tagline: Dapp that allow group members to access online events and join discussion
description: We aim to create a decentralised application that can interact with our membership nft contract, and implement member's only access to exclusive contents and events. To have access to exclusive content, you will need to pay our ERC20 token "PARTY" token to purchase membership. We use the graph's graphql query to the nft smart contract and fetch list of members.
how_its_made: We use a simple React Next.js application as the frontend and combination with Unlock Protocol's NFT membership contract to make it a member exclusive platform. To have access to exclusive content, you will need to pay our ERC20 token "PARTY" token to purchase membership. We use the graph's graphql query to the nft smart contract and fetch list of members.
